messages:
anna: Quick sync: deciding on validation UX for the dense Create Deployment form. Inline errors vs a top summary? Also how to mark required fields in dense layouts. jamal: For purely local field issues (bad URL, invalid number) inline only. For anything involving multiple fields or policy conflicts, surface a top summary that links to each field. lexi: Accessibility: any summary must be keyboard-focusable and announce when it appears. Use a `role=region` with `aria-live=polite` or programmatically move focus to it. mike: Inline errors should not cause content shift. Reserve the helper line under each input and toggle the text + color instead of inserting height. sam: About required markers in tight forms: avoid asterisks alone. Either include the literal word 'Required' in the label or append visually-hidden text to the accessible label. taylor: We also need to keep i18n in mind: make 'Required' a translatable token so other languages can change placement. anna: Confirmation patterns for destructive actions? Typed-confirm is safer but terrible on phones. Any proposals to scope its usage? jamal: Scope it: typed-confirm only for org-wide destructive actions (data purge, teardown). For per-resource deletes, use modal with a required checkbox + clear copy. lexi: If using typed-confirm, don't rely on a placeholder. Provide a visible label and announce mismatches with `role=\"alert\"`. Eg: `
confirmation text mismatch
`. mike: Implementation note: inputs should include `aria-invalid=\"true\"` and link to the error via `aria-describedby`. The summary links should use `href=\"#field-id\"` and on click move focus to the field so screen readers get context. sam: Visual token suggestion: render the 'Required' token with a muted color token (token.text.subtle) to reduce visual noise in long forms. anna: Draft decision for the component patch: 1) explicit 'Required' tokenized for i18n, 2) inline errors for single-field, reserved helper height to avoid shift, 3) top-of-step summary for cross-field/policy errors with focusable links, 4) typed-confirm only for org-scope destructive actions, 5) include aria-invalid/aria-describedby + role=alert examples in docs. taylor: I'll update the Figma components to show dense vs expanded label variants and add a copy token. mike: I'll prepare a small frontend playground showing the patterns (dense labels, reserved helper space, summary->field focus). Will include a11y attributes and a typed-confirm demo. design-bot: Created issue https://redwood.internals/issue/5932 "forms: dense form validation + scoped confirm patterns" :white_check_mark: anna: Thanks everyone — landing this next patch cycle if no objections.
